title: feat(router): support server environments
body:
## Description

This updates the `history` router to not rely on the `window` object, mainly to support server environments (required for SSR).

This is an in-between update before reworking the routing mechanism.

## Changes

- We guard around `window` access
- One optional params: `getLocation`
- The `history` router was not tested, I've covered the new code with tests

## API

### `getLocation`

> `() ⇒ Location` | defaults to `() => window.location`

Returns the location to store in the history.
